title: Classic Penne Pasta
description: A simple yet satisfying Italian-inspired pasta dish. Penne pasta is paired with a light and zesty sauce.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the penne pasta according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat. Add the garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the chopped rigate pasta to the skillet and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Drain the cooked penne pasta and add it to the skillet with the garlic and rigate.
If desired, garnish with chopped parsley and top with grated Parmesan cheese.
